new_hypothesis.name: pumpfun_local_fee_regime_filter
new_hypothesis.mechanism: Solana priority fees are localized PER PROGRAM (Helius 'local fee markets' finding), not global. When the Pump.fun bonding-curve program (6EF8rrecthR5Dkzon8Nwu78hRvfCKubJ14M5uBEwF6P) or Raydium AMM program experiences memecoin frenzy, the program-local 75th-percentile compute-unit price spikes 5-20x above baseline within seconds while the global Solana median barely moves. This localized fee burn is revealed-preference proof that sniper capital is actively bidding to land transactions into those exact pools NOW, 30-120 seconds before DexScreener trending registers the same activity (DexScreener has a 1-3 minute ingestion lag). Our bot currently has zero priority-fee regime awareness; in CHOP weeks the Pump.fun program-local fee market is dead-quiet. Gating buys to fire only when the program-local fee market is hot filters out the dead-tape periods responsible for our 7d 16.7% WR / 0.33 profit-factor.
new_hypothesis.persistence: Three persistence guards: (1) most retail Solana sniper bots query getRecentPrioritizationFees GLOBALLY without lockedWritableAccounts to compute how much fee to PAY, treating it as a cost input not a signal -- they have not flipped the lens to use the same RPC method as a regime detector; (2) sophisticated MEV searchers exploit fee asymmetry WITHIN single blocks via Jito bundles, but the 30-120s regime-detector window is too SLOW for them and too SOPHISTICATED for retail -- we sit in the gap; (3) the Helius local-fee-markets blog post made the mechanism public but operationalizing it requires a per-program rolling baseline and a regime-state-machine that copy-trade bots do not build because their UX is single-mint-buy-now not multi-mint-regime-gate.
new_hypothesis.entry_rules: Before any copy-trade or non-momentum buy fires: Step 1: call getRecentPrioritizationFees with lockedWritableAccounts=[PUMPFUN_PROGRAM_ID]. Step 2: compute p75_recent = 75th-percentile of last 150 slot samples returned. Step 3: maintain in-memory rolling 4h median of p75 values -> p75_baseline. Step 4: BUY-ALLOWED only if (p75_recent >= 3 * p75_baseline AND p75_recent >= 150000 microlamports/CU). Step 5: HARD-SKIP buy if p75_recent < 80000 microlamports/CU (cold tape, CHOP confirmed). Phase 1: LOG-ONLY -- record every buy decision PLUS the gate-status (would_allow|would_skip|cold_tape) to sol_pumpfun_fee_regime_log.json. Phase 2 (only after N>=30 logged decisions with paired forward-returns): activate gate as a hard filter.
new_hypothesis.data_required: Existing ALCHEMY_SOLANA_RPC from .env supports getRecentPrioritizationFees natively. Optional: Helius getPriorityFeeEstimate (free key already deployed in repo) as global comparator. Zero new dependencies. Single RPC call per buy decision, ~50ms latency.
new_hypothesis.evidence: Six converging public sources: (1) QuickNode Solana Priority Fee Tracker live: Low=61000, Medium=140000, High=281000 microLamports/CU -- confirms threshold scale and that High is a real 4.6x-above-low regime; (2) Helius docs expose 6 percentile bands (Min/Low/Medium/High/VeryHigh/UnsafeMax) via getPriorityFeeEstimate, validating per-percentile granularity; (3) Helius 'Truth about Solana Local Fee Markets' blog post: fees are program-localized, the core mechanism; (4) Dysnix 2026 sniper-bot report: contested launches require 0.02-0.05 SOL fees vs 0.001-0.005 SOL normal = 4-50x localized spike, quantitatively confirming regime-shift magnitude; (5) CoinDesk Jan 2026: PumpSwap hit record $1.2B volume during memecoin frenzy -- confirms frenzies are real datable events; (6) Yellow.com/CCN: AURA +164% on 2026-05-09, TROLL +77% on 2026-05-10 -- recent concrete frenzy windows the filter could be backtested against. Honesty note: live spot-check on May 9/10 specific mints NOT done this run (DexScreener WebFetch returned 403); first implementation step is paired backtest before Phase 2 gate activation.

proposals_for_survival_brain.justification: Genuinely novel mechanism class: NOT a Jito-related signal, NOT a deployer-graph signal, NOT a threshold tweak on an existing strategy. It is a Solana-program-localized fee-regime detector that exploits the documented Helius local-fee-markets finding. Mechanism: per-program p75 priority fee spikes 5-20x above baseline when sniper capital is hot on that program 30-120s before DexScreener trending registers it. Phase 1 LOG-ONLY: record gate-status (would_allow|would_skip|cold_tape) alongside every actual buy decision to sol_pumpfun_fee_regime_log.json. After N>=30 paired forward-return samples, evaluate whether the gate would have improved WR from current 16.7% to something materially better.
proposals_for_survival_brain.baseline: Overall rolling 7d: N=6 WR=16.7% R/R=1.22 PnL=-0.00255 SOL stop_rate=66.7%. proposals_for_survival_brain.expected_effect: Phase 1: ~10-20 logged gate decisions/day depending on bot trade activity (currently trade-dormant 18.85h so could be much sparser). After N=30 paired forward-return samples, brain compares 24h-return distribution of (gate_open trades) vs (gate_closed trades). proposals_for_survival_brain.kill_criteria: If after 14d Phase 1 logger has <30 paired buy+forward-return samples, signal too sparse -> drop. If after N=30 samples gate-open trades show <=+1pp WR lift over gate-closed (fee-regime uncorrelated with forward-returns), drop. If RPC method getRecentPrioritizationFees with lockedWritableAccounts returns malformed/empty data on >5% of polls, abandon as unworkable.
proposals_for_survival_brain.min_sample_size: N=30 paired buy + 5min-forward-return decisions inside Phase 1 window. Regime-stratified: at least 10 each from CHOP and BULL/BEAR windows if regime shifts during the experiment.
